title: Searches for a valid user and shows the profile details
description: This verifies that a visitor can search for a GitHub username and see the user's profile information after loading completes.

steps.description: Fill in the search input with a valid GitHub username
Verify a loading state is shown and then the user profile is displayed
Verify the avatar, login, location, followers, and following details are displayed

title: Shows a not-found state for an unknown user
description: This verifies that searching for a nonexistent GitHub username results in an error state instead of a profile.

steps.description: Fill in the search input with a nonexistent GitHub username
Verify a not-found error state is displayed

title: Searches with the keyboard and opens the profile repositories view
description: This verifies that a visitor can submit a user search with Enter and then navigate to the repositories view from the profile.

steps.description: Fill in the search input with a valid GitHub username
Verify the repositories view is displayed for the searched user
Verify the top repositories list is displayed

title: Opens the top five repositories for a user from the profile
description: This verifies that a visitor can open the repositories view from a profile and see the user's top five repositories sorted by stars.

steps.description: Fill in the search input with a valid GitHub username
Verify the top five repositories are displayed
Verify the repositories are sorted by stars

title: Rejects an empty search submission
description: This verifies that submitting an empty search shows an invalid-search outcome instead of a profile.

steps.description: Verify an invalid-search or validation error is displayed

title: Shows repository details for each top repository
description: This verifies that the repositories view shows each repository's name, language, stars, and forks.

steps.description: Verify the repository list is displayed
Verify repository name, language, stars, and forks are displayed for the listed repositories

title: Returns to the profile from the repositories view
description: This verifies that a visitor can return from the repositories view back to the previously viewed profile.

steps.description: Fill in the search input with a valid GitHub username
Verify the user profile is displayed again

title: Loads the repositories view directly for a username
description: This verifies that a direct visit to a user's repositories route shows the repository list without requiring prior navigation.

steps.description: Verify the repositories view is displayed
Verify the top repositories list is displayed

title: Opens a repository in GitHub from the repositories view
description: This verifies that a visitor can open a repository from the repositories view in a new browser tab.

steps.description: Verify the repository opens as an external GitHub destination in a new tab
